Introduction:
Bromoheal 2.5mg tablet is a reliable medical component used for managing a high level of prolactin in women. It also helps in treating female infertility, and acromegaly. The powerful ingredient gets into the body to act as an inhibitor by releasing prolactin (also known as milk hormone) into the body. It also helps at reducing the higher amount of hormonal growth in those with acromegaly conditions.

Product Details:
Bromoheal 2.5mg tablets are derived from Bromocriptine Mesylate to manage high levels of prolactin. Prolactin is a peculiar hormone found in the body of the female that helps in developing breasts while creating milk secretion. This bromocriptine tablet (pack of 10 tabs) each with 2.5mg strength helps to stop milk secretion in the breast in those females who have suffered from miscarriage, stillbirth, or abortion. These bromocriptine mesylate tablets chemically act in the brain as dopamine to gain control over those high levels of prolactin while inhibiting milk secretion.

Bromocriptine 2.5 mg tablet is used in female infertility to have regulated menstruation and ovulation cycles. Women who have irregular menstrual periods due to prolactin hormone in the body can have regular period cycles with Bromocriptine Mesylate tablets. Bromocriptine 2.5 mg tablet is used for treating acromegaly, a kind of hormonal disorder where the excess of hormone secretion affects the physical appearance of the body in an adult individual. Buy Bromoheal 2.5 mg online to reduce the levels of hormonal growth associated with acromegaly.

Action Mechanism:
Bromocriptine tablet by Healing Pharma is a dopamine receptor agonist that helps decline the release of prolactin in the body. Anyone with this overproduced hormone is interlinked with abnormal production of breast milk in females as well as suppression of the sexual glands leading to infertility. Bromocriptine 2.5 mg tablet helps reduce prolactin levels in an individual. Those with acromegaly, buy bromocriptine 2.5 mg tablet online to lower the level of growth hormone in the body.

Ensure to take Bromocriptine mesylate tablets in accurate dosage and duration as advised by your doctor. This tablet is swallowed as a whole and not meant to be chewed. Bromocriptine tablet is meant to be taken with food or as advised by your healthcare expert.

FAQ’s:

How is high prolactin level (hyperprolactinemia) diagnosed?

Conducting a blood test can show your prolactin level. In case it appears to be on the borderline, you might be asked to test twice for accuracy. The doctor may further examine the physical or conduct a brain MRI.

What is the ideal level of prolactin in the body?

The ideal level of prolactin in an individual male is: less than 20 ng/mL (425 µg/L) Non-pregnant women: less than 25 ng/mL (25 µg/L) and Pregnant women: between 80 to 400 ng/mL (80 to 400 µg/L)

What causes high prolactin in females?

At times high prolactin in females is not known. Some might have a noncancerous tumor in the pituitary gland, an underactive thyroid (hypothyroidism), or an overactive pituitary gland can lead to high prolactin. Other causes are side effects of certain medications or stress as well.

Can a woman get pregnant with high prolactin?

High levels of prolactin can inhibit the secretion of Follicle-stimulating hormone (FSH) that triggers ovulation. In case your prolactin levels spike, your ovulation can be suppressed. Hence, those women who are breastfeeding (with high levels of prolactin) usually don’t get pregnant.

Does Bromocriptine (Bromoheal) 2.5 mg tablet increases fertility?

Bromoheal 2.5 mg tablet alone cannot increase fertility. It solely helps to reduce high prolactin (hormone) levels. It further helps women to achieve a normal ovulation cycle.

Can I take my regular blood pressure medications while consuming Bromocriptine (Bromoheal) 2.5 mg tablet?

Taking Bromocriptine 2.5 mg tablet with any other blood pressure medications can drastically drop your blood pressure level leading to dizziness. For more clarity, consult your healthcare expert.
